🔮 AstroTrader Pro™ — Today’s sky — October 12, 2026

Moon, in its fall in Scorpio, holds a square to Mars, in Leo. Two tempers that rarely agree, briefly aligned: the wanting and the sum are audible in the same room.

Easier — Noticing which of your commitments you never actually chose.
Harder — Forcing a decision that only needs to be described honestly.
Backdrop — Neptune and Pluto hold a month-long sextile underneath all of it.

♈ ARIES
Mars rules you from Leo, untitled. Sun faces you from Libra: your measure comes back as someone else’s. Cardinal fire: the beginning has a price on it. Mars has not been in Cancer for four weeks.

♉ TAURUS
Venus, your ruler, is in detriment in Scorpio, working in a borrowed language. From Scorpio, Moon quotes your worth back at you. Fixed earth: the grip is the expense. What pressed a week ago has cleared.

♊ GEMINI
Mercury, your ruler, crosses Scorpio untitled. Mars in Leo opens a gap you have to step into. Air bends, and bending costs nothing here. Since Mercury crossed out of Libra, the question has changed.

♋ CANCER
Moon, your ruler, falls in Scorpio. Sun in Libra squares you: the price shows before the wish does. Cardinal water starts and is invoiced for it. The sextile to Sun that held a week ago has let go.

♌ LEO
Sun governs you, unsupported in Libra. Mars is with you, close enough to read the small print. Fire holds on until the thing and the self are one. Four weeks of Virgo ended, and nothing carried over.

♍ VIRGO
Mercury governs you, untitled in Scorpio. From Scorpio, Moon offers an angle — offered, not delivered. Earth adapts, and adapting costs nothing here. The hold Moon had a week ago is not there any more.

♎ LIBRA
Venus rules you, exiled in Scorpio. From Leo, Mars hands you an opening. Cardinal air: the opening move is the cheap one. Retrograde since two weeks ago, Venus is still re-reading.

♏ SCORPIO
Mars rules you and passes through Leo as a guest. Moon crosses your sign, and nothing stays general. Water holds until owning and being coincide. A week ago Mars was still held by Moon; that is finished.

♐ SAGITTARIUS
Jupiter, your ruler, is only passing through Leo. Mars trines you from Leo, and what you hold finds words unforced. Mutable fire: two answers, neither expensive. The sextile of three weeks ago is off it now.

♑ CAPRICORN
Saturn governs you from Aries, where it stands lowest. Moon sextiles you from Scorpio: help that waits to be asked for. Cardinal earth opens the account without argument. Sun let go of it a week ago.

♒ AQUARIUS
Saturn rules you, fallen in Aries. From Scorpio, Moon cuts across you: the sum arrives before the appetite. Fixed air: the grip costs more than the thing. It arrived inside the last seven days.

♓ PISCES
Jupiter, your ruler, is only passing through Leo. Moon in Scorpio sides with you before you have argued. Mutable water: two answers, and both are affordable. This is days old, not weeks, and behaves like it.
